Ordering Terms

Please confirm your project details before production.

Quotes and approval

Availability, final pricing, payment requirements, and delivery timing are confirmed with your quote. Production starts after artwork approval and payment. Check spelling, colors, sizes, quantities, and print placement carefully before approving.

Timing and delivery

Typical turnaround is 7–10 business days after artwork approval and payment. This is an estimate; your confirmed order details govern timing. Local delivery is free within Citrus and Hernando counties and arranged directly.

Your artwork

Provide artwork that you own or have permission to reproduce. Concept images on this site illustrate possible apparel styles and are not representations of completed customer work.

Changes or concerns

Contact us promptly about order changes or a problem with delivered apparel. Changes after approval may affect cost and timing. Any cancellation or return conditions will be confirmed before you place your order. These terms do not limit rights available under applicable law.
